question: ¿Cuántos ensayos clínicos de linfoma iniciados desde 2020 prueban rituximab?

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug d ON d.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id
WHERE d.pref_name = 'RITUXIMAB' AND md.label = 'Lymphoma'
  AND s.start_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
